I am an old man now, 81 years, and I have farmed this land my whole life. This small plot of beans I keep close to the house, and beans do not need the fertilizer like maize does — they find their own nitrogen in the soil, this I learned long ago from my father. I will put some manure from the goats I keep, because the soil is tired after so many seasons, but I cannot spend cash on chemical fertilizer for beans when my maize plots need it more. My children help me some days, but mostly I do the work myself, slowly, as my legs allow.
